title: Users
content: The Users page lets you view, filter, and manage everyone who has access to your clinic's mGrape account — from Admins and Managers down to individual branch Users.

title: Open Users
content: Click here to open the Users page.

title: Add User
content: Click this button to invite a new team member. You will enter their email, assign them a role, and optionally link them to a specific branch — then the platform sends them an invite link.

title: User Filters
content: Filter the user list by role or branch to quickly find the person you are looking for. Use Reset Filters to return to the full list.

title: Filter by Role
content: Narrow the list to Admin, Manager, or User accounts. Useful when you want to audit who holds elevated access across the clinic.

title: Filter by Branch
content: Show only users assigned to a specific branch. Managers and Admins see all branches; this filter helps you focus on one site at a time.

title: User List
content: All registered users for your hospital appear here. Admins can invite new users, track invite status, and resend invite links directly from this table.

title: Users Table
content: Each row represents one user account. The table covers identity, access level, branch assignment, account standing, and login activity — everything you need to manage your team at a glance.

title: Invite a New User
content: Let's walk through the invite flow. Click the Add User button to open the invite modal.

title: Invite User Modal
content: This modal collects the minimum information needed to add someone to your clinic account — their email, the role they should have, and the branch if they are a standard User.

title: Email Address
content: Enter the person's work email. The platform validates the format before allowing the invite to be sent — no typos means no lost invites.

title: Assign a Role
content: Choose User, Manager, or Admin. Selecting User reveals an additional Branch field — every standard user must be linked to one branch so the system can scope their data access correctly.

title: Send or Cancel
content: Send Invite emails the invite link immediately. The link expires after one week — if the user misses it, use the Resend Invite link in the Users table to issue a fresh one.
